quote.description: The sentence, bullet or table row stating the action, copied exactly from the reply.

size_pct.description: Share of total capital in percentage points, or null.

size_text.description: The size as the reply words it, or null.

price.description: Plain number, no currency symbol or separators, or null.

alt_group.description: G1, G2, ... for items in a set of alternatives; otherwise null.

alt_option.description: A, B, ... for the alternative the item belongs to; otherwise null.

review_triggers.description: Sentences copied exactly that say what would prompt the next move or review without telling the person to act.

unclear_note.description: Null unless a recommendation cannot be fitted into the fields at all; then one sentence describing the problem.
